recipe.optimizer: AdamW betas (0.9, 0.95), weight decay 0.1 on matrices, grad clip 1.0
recipe.lr: peak 0.001, linear warmup 100 steps, cosine decay to 0.1 x peak at step 15000
recipe.data: Python source files (codeparrot-clean), byte-level BPE with 8192 tokens, files joined by <|eos|>=0
recipe.note: after your edit, training resumes from this step with the same optimizer state and the same batch sequence, until total_steps
